svg.title: IBM Integration and IBM MQ in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: 400+: prebuilt connectors and integration capabilities. IBM Integration, for enterprise apps, cloud services, databases and other systems. 10.0 LTS: IBM MQ 10.0, a Long Term Support release. Generally available from June 16, 2026, and from June 19, 2026 for MQ for z/OS. 14 days: an Aspera trial. With up to 50GB of transfer volume, as IBM offers it. Each figure is IBM’s. IBM states no test conditions for them.
